en: The Dhāraṇī-mantra of the Sūtra on the Ambrosia Spoken by the Buddha.
Namo surupāya tathāgatāya tadyathā oṃ suru suru vara suru vara suru svāhā.
Recite the *Aṣṭāyur* mantra seven times over a handful of water and scatter it into the air.
Each drop of that water will transform into ten *shu* of nectar (*amṛta*),
which all hungry ghosts (*preta*) shall be able to drink.
There was no lack of anything; all were completely satiated.
